pass_condition:
For EVERY seed in {0,1,2}:
  solve_rate_binary > solve_rate_masked
AND mean_over_seeds(solve_rate_binary - solve_rate_masked) >= 0.05 (at least a 5 percentage-point mean gap).
status_rule: PASS if the pass_condition holds. PARTIAL if mean(binary) > mean(masked) but the every-seed strict win or the 5pp mean-gap fails. FAIL otherwise (including ties or masked ahead on mean).
